name: agent
sql: SELECT id, binding_id, workflow_id, version_id, channel_id, thread_id, state, waiting_reason, revision, actor_id, parent_run_id, rerun_of_run_id, created_at, deadline, finished_at FROM (SELECT version.id AS used_version FROM workflow_versions AS version WHERE version.company_id = $1 AND $2 = ANY(version.agent_ids)) AS agent_versions CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT id, binding_id, workflow_id, version_id, channel_id, thread_id, state, waiting_reason, revision, actor_id, parent_run_id, rerun_of_run_id, created_at, deadline, finished_at FROM workflow_runs WHERE company_id = $3 AND version_id = agent_versions.used_version ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT $4) AS run ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT $5

name: board_counts
sql: WITH working AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT state, channel_id, binding_id, workflow_id, version_id FROM workflow_runs WHERE company_id = $1 AND state IN ('queued', 'running', 'waiting') AND parent_run_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT state, channel_id, binding_id, workflow_id, version_id FROM workflow_runs WHERE company_id = $2 AND finished_at >= $3 AND parent_run_id IS NULL) SELECT state, channel_id, COUNT(*)::bigint AS runs FROM working GROUP BY state, channel_id

workflow_runs WHERE company_id = $1 AND state = 'queued' AND parent_run_id IS NULL AND (channel_id = ANY($2) OR (channel_id IS NULL AND $3)) ORDER BY created_at, id LIMIT 51) UNION ALL (SELECT id, binding_id, workflow_id, version_id, channel_id, thread_id, state, waiting_reason, revision, actor_id, parent_run_id, rerun_of_run_id, created_at, deadline, finished_at FROM workflow_runs WHERE AND state = 'waiting' AND parent_run_id IS NULL AND (channel_id = ANY($8) OR (channel_id IS NULL AND $9)) ORDER BY created_at, id LIMIT 51) UNION ALL (SELECT id, binding_id, workflow_id, version_id, channel_id, thread_id, state, waiting_reason, revision, actor_id, parent_run_id, rerun_of_run_id, created_at, deadline, finished_at FROM workflow_runs WHERE company_id = $10 AND state = 'succeeded' AND parent_run_id IS NULL AND (channel_id = ANY($11) OR (channel_id IS NULL AND $12)) AND finished_at >= $13 ORDER BY finished_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 51) UNION ALL (SELECT id, binding_id, workflow_id, version_id, channel_id, thread_id, state, waiting_reason, revision, actor_id, parent_run_id, rerun_of_run_id, created_at, deadline, finished_at FROM workflow_runs WHERE company_id = $14 AND state = workflow_id, version_id, channel_id, thread_id, state, waiting_reason, revision, actor_id, parent_run_id, rerun_of_run_id, created_at, deadline, finished_at FROM workflow_runs WHERE company_id = $18 AND state = 'cancelled' AND parent_run_id IS NULL AND (channel_id = ANY($19) OR (channel_id IS NULL AND $20)) AND finished_at >= $21 ORDER BY finished_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 51)
